_comment_graceful_degradation: DEFAULT: Missing tools warn but don't block. Features requiring them are disabled.
_comment_strict_prereqs: Set to true to fail startup if any required tools are missing (production mode)
_comment_skip_prereqs: Set to true to skip all tool detection checks (if detection is broken)
_comment_skip_prereqs_list: List specific tools to skip checking (e.g., ['node', 'gh', 'tsc'])

task.title: OpenClaw community research (nightly)
task.notes:
Research how people are using OpenClaw successfully. Focus on real usage patterns, success stories, pain points, and feature requests.

Sources to check (as available):
- OpenClaw Discord (success stories, help threads, feature requests)
- GitHub issues + discussions
- Twitter/X (search for OpenClaw)
- Blog posts / demos / writeups

Output format:
- Title + date
- 5-10 bullet summary
- Success stories (with links)
- Pain points / blockers (with links)
- Feature requests (with links)
- Suggested next actions

stages.title: [openclaw-community-research] research
stages.notes:
Goal: gather actionable insights about how people are using OpenClaw successfully.

Look for:
- Success stories and concrete workflows
- Common pain points / failure modes
- Feature requests and missing docs
- Confusions about setup/config

Structure your output:
1) Executive summary (bullets)
2) Notable success stories (link + 1-2 sentences)
3) Pain points (link + impact)
4) Feature requests (link + frequency)
5) Recommendations for next steps

stages.title: [openclaw-community-research] report
stages.notes:
Write a concise, decision-ready report based on the research input.

Format:
- Executive summary (5 bullets max)
- Key themes (with supporting examples)
- Recommendations (ordered, with rationale)
- Appendix: source links

Keep it actionable; avoid raw dumps.

stages.title: [openclaw-community-research] design
stages.notes: Create a design proposal for the top recommended improvements from the approved report. Include tradeoffs and an incremental implementation plan.

stages.title: [openclaw-community-research] implement
stages.notes: Implement the approved design changes. Use the design doc as input and keep changes scoped + tested.
